product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle helps enterprise digital, engineering, marketing and ecommerce teams quantify the revenue lost to website and mobile-app friction, prioritize fixes and validate their revenue impact.

pricing_page.notes: A publicly accessible plan-comparison page lists packages and enterprise custom pricing; the main-site /pricing page was unavailable.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Glen Allen as headquarters; some other directories use Richmond or Mechanicsville.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is primarily product announcements, digital-experience guidance and marketing content; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored posts about building Blue Triangle was established.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job-board page explicitly says it has no jobs relevant to that board at this time; no qualifying live posting was found.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model/provider is publicly identified in the AI documentation, AI/product FAQs, blog, privacy/security materials or disclosed subprocessor list. Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor are documented as external MCP clients, not as Blue Triangle’s internal model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center offers SOC-2 and ISO27001 documentation on request. GDPR is an explicit compliance claim in the privacy policy, not a standalone certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest recorded round is dated November 9, 2021; its amount is undisclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round is November 9, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company board lists no relevant jobs; the historical SDR posting explicitly states that it no longer accepts applications.

launched_6mo.notes: The MCP connector was announced in August 2026, and the Revenue Assurance platform in July 2026, both inside May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The six-person published leadership team was checked against employment histories; company joins predate November 9, 2025, and no dated departure was found. Emily Salzer’s January 2026 VP appointment was an internal promotion, not a company join.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Historical SDR recruiting names all four in desired tool experience; current MCP documentation also describes HubSpot and ZoomInfo workflows. These are public stack signals, not confirmation that all four remain in internal use.
